# Service Pro (ServicePro), also known as DetailPro

> Service Pro builds the next generation of local service businesses. We build and run the whole operating system of a local service business, and we get paid when the owner gets paid.

Service Pro is operated by MOTO Technology, LLC dba ServicePro (formerly and still also known as DetailPro) in Chanhassen, Minnesota. The DetailPro name and the detailpro.tech domain remain in use.

## What Service Pro is

Service Pro gives local service business owners the technology, systems, and mentorship to build a real, profitable company. It is not an agency, a CRM, a course, or a franchise. The owner keeps 100% of the business. Service Pro takes no equity and charges no retainer.

The mechanism in one line: ads bring calls, every call gets answered, jobs get booked, and customers come back, without the owner in the office.

Service Pro is selective. It only takes owners it believes will succeed, and it takes one partner per trade in each market.

## Who it serves

Any local service business, including HVAC, plumbing, roofing, lawn care, pool cleaning, pressure washing, window cleaning, and detailing. There are two kinds of owners:

- New owners deciding what to build, from pre-launch to year two. They start with the same system the big players already have.
- Established owners with 15 to 30+ years in the business who want a company that runs, and sells, without them.

## What is included

- A website built to turn local searches into booked calls
- Google Business Profile, reviews, and Local Services Ads
- Google and Meta ads that scale up or down with the owner's schedule
- An AI voice agent that answers every call 24/7, checks the service area, and books jobs
- A CRM with rebooking, review requests, and past-customer reactivation
- SEO and AEO (showing up in AI search), a referral engine, and books and legal partners
- Mentorship and playbooks for pricing, first hires, and operations

## How it works

Service Pro builds the system in four weeks, then runs it.

1. Week 1, Build: website, Google profile, phone numbers, CRM, pricing, and service area.
2. Week 2, Connect: systems plugged into how the business runs, call scripts and booking rules, ad tracking.
3. Week 3, Launch: ads and call answering go live and leads flow into the CRM.
4. Week 4, Hand off: owner training, dashboards, and a weekly rhythm while the automations take over.

## How Service Pro gets paid

Service Pro gets paid mainly through a revenue share, so it only wins when the owner does. In a month with no revenue, its share is zero. There is a one-time buildout and a monthly infrastructure fee. Exact terms are covered during the application process. There is no guarantee of results, income, or a number of jobs.

## Founder

Brady Schlapkohl. Two years ago he started Shine Squad, a detailing company, and built it into one of the largest in Minneapolis within a year. His edge was modern systems applied to an old-fashioned industry.
